overloads.semanticRole: Returns a collection describing every step of the current process's method call chain (method/formula, calling database/component, and line number), equivalent to the Debugger window's call stack.

constraints: Works from any 4D environment including compiled mode, but requires Range checking to not be disabled for the command to operate correctly in compiled mode.
The 'formula' property of a returned object is omitted (Undefined) when the corresponding source code is not available.
